description:
Google Maps for ReVanced GmsCore

- Renames app-owned custom permissions to the patched Maps namespace, preventing duplicate-permission installation conflicts with original Google Maps.
- Suppresses the misleading Google Play services update notification for an unavailable optional feature without reporting that feature as supported.
- Supports Google Maps 26.30.09.950492155 and the earlier declared compatible versions.
